Definition: to amaze, i.e. (reflex. by implication) take alarm
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tᵉvahh is the word for to be amazed, to take alarm. In Daniel 3:24, Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied.
TheologicalSignificance: A king left astonished by men walking unharmed in fire makes me trust that God can stand with His people inside the flames.
